overview: The uploaded textbook chapter 'Our School — A Happy Place' develops observation, evidence, everyday application and connected understanding through 'Our School — A Happy Place'.
source_grounded_key_points: Green School Aasha and Mohit were walking to school together.
Mohit smiled happily and said, “I love school!
It is where I see my friends, play games and learn new things every day.
Our school is a place where we feel safe, and cared for.
Asha said, “My school teaches us how to care for plants, trees and animals.
I want to make my school better like a green school”.
“My brother told me once, green school is a school where we manage our waste, save water, use electricity carefully, and make the campus green by planting more trees and taking care of them”.
Aasha and Mohit share their idea with their classmates.
